authority: Complete API before/after diagnostic vectors and pinned provider message vectors authored from producer/descriptor and official v10.9.2 sources before execution. No output capture is used to regenerate expectations.

contract.scope: Remove only the 14-name bare-instance deny list. Preserve all current prefix diagnostics and tracked groups.
contract.cliHelpSerialization: The built-in script merge path appends producer help unchanged; JSON maps d.help unconditionally. --help-level none is the invocation flag, not a removal of this rule's serialized help.

retainedProviderDifferences: Patina reserves arbitrary $-prefixed keys; provider reserves only exact vue-reserved.json names.
Patina reserves arbitrary underscore-prefixed keys across its tracked groups; provider underscore check is limited to data/asyncData.
Patina tracks inject while the provider default no-reserved-keys groups omit inject; asyncData provider behavior is not added by this narrow correction.
